S1214.reason: Under the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, heads of state, heads of government, foreign ministers, and heads of diplomatic missions are presumed competent to conclude treaties.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction allows any state to exercise jurisdiction over certain serious international crimes regardless of where committed or the nationality of the parties.

S1059.reason: In arbitral tribunals, the parties typically appoint the arbitrators, often each appointing one and those agreeing on a presiding arbitrator.
